verdict.rationale: Fin's own pages describe in-product AI analytics. AI-powered Insights continuously analyzes every Fin and human conversation, and the suite lists AI Topics, Trends, AI Recommendations, Monitors and Incident Detection, which together cover both AI-generated insights and suggestions. The evidence is short marketing lines rather than in-depth docs. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of how Insights and Recommendations generate and present suggestions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that they work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
